## Steps to reproduce

Include the scheme (Preview or Live), macOS and Xcode versions, the commit or app version, and the smallest sequence that triggers the problem.

## Expected and observed behavior

For Live, distinguish unavailable monitoring, no sessions, and an unexpected session state. Provide synthetic data or redacted screenshots.
